fusions.name: Gorgon's Flicker
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 14 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds, its Speed drained.

fusions.name: Found Fault
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 30 damage, ignoring the target's armour, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Stones
fusions.desc: Raises a line of standing stones 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Perched Gargoyle
fusions.desc: A bonded gargoyle perches beside you and strikes an enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.
